tokens.name: notch-black
tokens.usage: Tokens.Colors.notchBlack. The hardware notch. Everything touching the notch line is exactly this: the closed shape, the wings and the top cap of the open panel.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Tokens.Colors.textPrimary. Titles, body, numerics and display figures on notch-black, the panel glass and card-fill. 21:1 on black, about 8:1 low in the panel over a white desktop.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Tokens.Colors.textSecondary. Captions, details and timestamps, and plain icon buttons at rest, on the panel glass and card-fill. 7.8:1 on black; can fall to about 4.3:1 low in the panel over a pure-white desktop.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Tokens.Colors.textTertiary. Section labels (10 pt uppercase) and empty-state symbols on the panel glass. 3.4:1 on black, under the 4.5:1 floor for small text; the source value is kept exact and flagged. 0.50 would reach 5.3:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Tokens.Colors.accent, Color(red: 0.25, green: 0.62, blue: 1.0). The single accent: progress rings, the active drop outline, accent glyphs in the wings, focus rings in the web previews. 7.5:1 on notch-black.

tokens.name: accent-glass
tokens.usage: accent.opacity(0.75), the tint of the accent GlassButton. A text-primary label on it measures about 4.3:1 over the dark panel; source pair kept exact.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: accent.opacity(0.14), the fill of a highlighted GlassCard: an active drop target or a selected item. Always paired with a 1.5 pt accent outline.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Tokens.Colors.success, Color(red: 0.30, green: 0.85, blue: 0.48). Savings figures and finished work on the panel glass. 11.5:1 on black. Its lightness is close to warning, so pair it with a word, a figure or a symbol, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Tokens.Colors.warning, Color(red: 1.0, green: 0.66, blue: 0.20). Something needs the user: a pulsing dot, a waiting session. 10.9:1 on black. Pair it with a word or symbol; it is not distinguishable from success by lightness.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Tokens.Colors.glassTint. The tint mixed into the panel's Liquid Glass, under the glass-floor veil.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Web stand-in, not in the Swift source: the body of interactive glass (GlassButton, GlassIconButton), which macOS draws with .glassEffect(.regular.interactive()).

tokens.name: glass-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Web stand-in: interactive glass under the pointer.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: Web stand-in: the bright specular edge Liquid Glass catches along the panel's lower rim and the top of glass controls.

tokens.name: glass-rim-soft
tokens.usage: Web stand-in: the faint side of the glass edge, where the rim fades toward the black cap.

tokens.name: card-fill
tokens.usage: Tokens.Colors.cardFill. GlassCard at rest and the square behind a ResultRow symbol.

tokens.name: card-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Tokens.Colors.cardFillHover. Hover fill of row buttons and plain icon buttons.

tokens.name: card-stroke
tokens.usage: Tokens.Colors.cardStroke. The 1 pt outline of a GlassCard and the track of a ProgressRing or scrubber.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Tokens.Colors.hairline. Dividers inside a card; the edge of artwork and thumbnails.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif
families.rounded: ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: title
styles.usage: 13 semibold, text-primary. Card titles and the main line of a row.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: 12 regular, text-primary. Row titles and clip previews.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: 10 semibold, uppercase, 0.6 pt tracking, text-tertiary. Section labels only.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: 12 medium with monospaced digits, text-primary or a TintRole. Sizes, percentages, countdowns.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: 20 semibold rounded with monospaced digits, text-primary. One hero figure per card at most.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Tokens.Spacing.xs. Symbol to label in a SectionHeader; lines inside an EmptyState.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Tokens.Spacing.s. The default gap between a card's children; thumbnail to text in a ResultRow.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Tokens.Spacing.m. GlassCard padding.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Tokens.Spacing.l. The largest step: roomy padding in the drop target.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Tokens.Radius.card. GlassCard, continuous corners.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Tokens.Radius.control. Row buttons and other rectangular controls; large artwork.

tokens.name: radius-thumbnail
tokens.usage: Tokens.Radius.thumbnail. ResultRow thumbnails and wing artwork.

tokens.name: radius-notch-closed-top
tokens.usage: Tokens.Radius.notchClosedTop. The concave ears of the closed notch.

tokens.name: radius-notch-closed-bottom
tokens.usage: Tokens.Radius.notchClosedBottom. The convex bottom corners of the closed notch.

tokens.name: radius-notch-open-top
tokens.usage: Tokens.Radius.notchOpenTop. The ears of the drop target and the expanded panel.

tokens.name: radius-notch-open-bottom
tokens.usage: Tokens.Radius.notchOpenBottom. The bottom corners of the drop target and the expanded panel.

tokens.name: glass-shadow
tokens.usage: Web stand-in for the shadow macOS casts under Liquid Glass. Under the open panel only; the closed notch casts none.

layout.note: PanelLayout: sizes of the notch's states, in points. The notch band (height = the hardware notch) sits on top of the content sizes given here.

tokens.name: wing-width
tokens.usage: PanelLayout.wingWidth. Each live-activity wing beside the closed notch.

tokens.name: hover-growth-width
tokens.usage: PanelLayout.hoverGrowth.width. How much wider the notch swells on hover.

tokens.name: hover-growth-height
tokens.usage: PanelLayout.hoverGrowth.height. How much taller the notch swells on hover.

tokens.name: drop-width
tokens.usage: PanelLayout.dropSize.width. The drop target shown while a drag is near the notch.

tokens.name: drop-height
tokens.usage: PanelLayout.dropSize.height, below the notch band.

tokens.name: expanded-width
tokens.usage: PanelLayout.expandedSize.width. The expanded panel.

tokens.name: expanded-height
tokens.usage: PanelLayout.expandedSize.height, below the notch band.

tokens.name: inset-top
tokens.usage: PanelLayout.contentInsets.top. Content starts this far below the notch band.

tokens.name: inset-side
tokens.usage: PanelLayout.contentInsets leading and trailing.

tokens.name: inset-bottom
tokens.usage: PanelLayout.contentInsets.bottom.

tokens.name: panel-gap
tokens.usage: PanelLayout.gap. Between dashboard cards. At the default size a column is 210 pt wide; cards are 87 or 184 pt tall; a page gets 652 × 184.

tokens.name: cap-fade
tokens.usage: NotchSurface. The distance over which the black cap melts into the glass below it.

glass.note: The panel's Liquid Glass. glass-floor is from the Swift source; blur and saturate are web stand-ins for what .glassEffect does natively.

tokens.name: glass-floor
tokens.usage: Tokens.Colors.glassFloor. How dark the surface stays below the black cap: 0 is pure glass, 1 is black.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Web stand-in: backdrop blur behind the panel.

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: Web stand-in: backdrop saturation behind the panel, so desktop colour survives the dark tint.
